latest_cos_commentary.headline: Tillster is a San Diego-based unified-commerce platform for QSR/fast-casual chains, spanning ordering, kiosks, loyalty, and menu management, and is active in industry research/thought leadership through its Phygital Index.
latest_cos_commentary.genius_exposure: Competes directly with Genius on digital_menu_boards, kitchen_drive_thru-adjacent ordering flow, and loyalty_engagement; less direct overlap on core payments/back_office.
latest_cos_commentary.competitive_timing: Published a large diner-behavior survey in July 2026 highlighting declining restaurant loyalty and rising kiosk acceptance — useful market context when discussing digital ordering investment with prospects.
latest_cos_commentary.sales_response: When Tillster's own research on kiosk/self-service satisfaction comes up, note it reflects industry-wide sentiment, not a claim specific to Tillster's platform performance.
latest_cos_commentary.risk_and_uncertainty: No named restaurant customers, leadership, or financial details were verified in this pass.
